crossRefs.note: Then I said, “Surely these are poor. They are foolish; for they don’t know the Yahweh’s way, nor the law of their God.
“For my people are foolish. They don’t know me. They are foolish children, and they have no understanding. They are…
Yes, the stork in the sky knows her appointed times. The turtledove, the swallow, and the crane observe the time of…
But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you…
Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
They don’t know, neither do they consider: for he has shut their eyes, that they can’t see; and their hearts, that they…
“Son of man, you dwell in the middle of the rebellious house, who have eyes to see, and don’t see, who have ears to…
Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they…
“He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their…
saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see…
According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should…
Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
“Ephraim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Egypt. They go to Assyria.

translations.web: ‘Hear this now, foolish people without understanding, who have eyes, and don’t see, who have ears, and don’t hear:
translations.bsb: “Hear this, O foolish and senseless people, who have eyes but do not see, who have ears but do not hear.
translations.kjv: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; which have eyes, and see not; which have ears, and hear
translations.asv: Hear now this, O foolish people, and without understanding; that have eyes, and see not; that have ears, and hear not:
